original_test_intent: Verify functional communication from HMC I2C-2 to FPGA1 through the correct HMC bus3 path by reading the approved FPGA register and validating its three-byte response.
original_method: Map HMC I2C-2 to Linux bus3, identify0x11 as FPGA1 and register0x0400 as a safe query; collect bus owner and HMC/FPGA error baseline; issue one bounded combined pointer-write/read; decode the three bytes against the FPGA specification; correlate HMC I2C-2/FPGA1 telemetry and ensure no new errors.
manual_activity: HMC/FPGA owner supplies the HMC I2C-2-to-bus3 map,0x11/register specification, expected three bytes, ownership and recovery; physical probing is not inferred.
required_inputs: PID1114953 mapping of HMC I2C-2 to HMC Linux bus3 and FPGA1 address0x11
FPGA1 device identity and vendor definition for register0x0400
Expected three-byte value/field masks by FPGA1 firmware/version
Proof the write phase only sets a read pointer and is non-mutating
HMC bus3 owner/driver and exclusive-access policy
Timeout/NACK/retry acceptance, HMC/FPGA error counters and recovery
safety_requirements: Verify bus3 and0x11 identity before access
Confirm0x0400 combined transaction is a read-only operation for this FPGA revision
Do not bypass an owning driver or perform concurrent raw transfers
Use one bounded request and capture first failure without automatic retry
Stop on wrong length/value, NACK, timeout, arbitration loss, stuck bus or HMC/FPGA degradation
agent_execution_scope: Collect HMC/FPGA identity, topology, owner and error baseline
After approval, execute exactly one combined read and decode the three bytes
Do not probe/solder, access the same-code SEL row, guess register meaning, scan or write other addresses, reset HMC/FPGA or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve0x0400 semantics and expected three-byte decoder
Approve raw-access ownership, timeout/abort and recovery
Review path-specific transaction and telemetry and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incorrect: the source provides a remotely executable HMC-side transaction, not a physical-probe procedure.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After mapping/protocol approval, retain `i2ctransfer -y 3 w2@0x11 0x04 0x00 r3` as one bounded combined read; capture complete output/status/latency and decode all three bytes using the FPGA1 register spec.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: HMC execution, bus3, address0x11, register bytes0x04/0x00, r3, FPGA1, HMC I2C-2, PID1114953 and 15/5-minute scope are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a single approved HMC-to-FPGA1 register read with path-specific mapping, decoded response and error-counter correlation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds controller/target identity, device semantics, expected fields, ownership and bounded error evidence while rejecting invented physical probing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An ACK or undecoded three-byte reply from0x11 does not establish that bus3 is HMC I2C-2 or the responder is FPGA1.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An incorrect register assumption can mutate FPGA state; controller retries may hide intermittent faults; a functional reply does not measure analog margin.

project_override_considerations: Wistron I2C policy assigns this to HMC/platform-management scope and requires controller/bus/address, vendor protocol, expected response and recovery before raw access.
expected_evidence: PID map proving HMC I2C-2-to-bus3 and FPGA1-at0x11
HMC/FPGA1 identities, firmware, bus owner/driver and pre-health baseline
Vendor register0x0400 definition and expected three-byte matrix
Timestamped exact transaction, stdout/stderr, exit code, latency and decoded fields
Pre/post HMC I2C and FPGA error/status counters without automatic-retry masking
Post-read HMC/FPGA health and engineer verdict

Confirm physical probing/photos are not core acceptance unless separately scoped.

review_improvement: Preserves duplicate-code source identity and replaces an unsupported physical-only verdict with a guarded, decoded HMC-to-FPGA1 functional read.
independent_technical_reasoning: This row can be exercised remotely because it supplies a precise HMC-side combined transaction. Its engineering uncertainty is not physical access but semantic attribution: bus3 must be HMC I2C-2,0x11 must be FPGA1, and0x0400 must safely return meaningful three-byte status. The unrelated same-code SEL row makes variant-bound evidence essential. Once those facts are supplied, one bounded read plus path-specific counters is appropriate coverage.
